# Overview (Trainee Role)

You are the animal in today’s activity. Your partner (the “trainer”) will attempt to teach you behaviors using clicks and candy rewards.

Rules for the “Animal” (Important!)
	•	NO talking to your trainer.
	•	You have NO information about what behavior the trainer wants from you.
	•	Your only clues are:
	•	Clicks from a clicker (meaning you did something right)
	•	Receiving candy (reward for correct behavior)

Your Goal
	•	Try to figure out what your trainer wants from you by paying close attention to when you hear clicks.
	•	Behaviors may start simple and become more complex over time. Stay patient and attentive!
	
Activity Steps (Trainee)
	•	Phase 1: You will receive candy after a “click.” Just wait and see what happens.
	•	Phase 2: Your trainer will begin clicking only when you do certain behaviors or movements. Experiment gently if unsure—observe carefully to see what earns clicks.
	•	Phase 3: Your trainer might introduce an object (stick, pointer). Explore interactions carefully to see what behaviors receive rewards.
	
Trainee Reflection Questions

Please answer briefly (1–3 sentences) and submit responses for grading:
	1.	Understanding the Task: How did you initially feel when you didn’t understand exactly what your trainer wanted?
	2.	Learning Process: What helped you understand what behaviors were rewarded?
	3.	Animal Perspective: How does this exercise help you understand the challenges animals might face when trainers are unclear or inconsistent?
